purpose: Five four-page website UI concept boards; one content-correction pass after visual inspection
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI mockup text correction.
Edit the supplied four-page My Lyrics website design board. KEEP the same overall 2x2 composition, all four page layouts, colors, typography character, whitespace, component sizes, sidebars, four panel labels, and concept title. Retain polished high-fidelity rendering. Do not redesign the layout. Make these content corrections consistently everywhere they appear:
1. The app's sample song is the actual My Lyrics English guide song, not a religious hymn. In EVERY app preview and any JSON example, keep the title "Song of Creation" and number "1", but replace all invented creation/God/praise lyrics with these exact lines:
"This app is empty, it starts off bare,"
"The content is yours, create if you dare."
"Fill it with stories, melodies, and more,"
"The journey's just started, what are you waiting for?"
Then verse number 2 and:
"Compose your own tunes, write lyrics that flow,"
"There's no wrong answer, just give it a go."
"The app is your canvas, your stage, your song,"
"Express what you feel, you can't go wrong."
Use readable small text and slightly fewer visible lines if necessary, not different lyrics. All sample book names stay "My Lyrics". No other book or song names. All app bottom tabs: Library, Search, Book, Collections, Settings, with Book active for the song page.
2. Replace every invented contact email with the real support email "laurelltm@gmail.com".
3. Privacy effective date is "May 14, 2026". For the privacy mockup use only this factual short text, arranged in its existing headings:
"My Lyrics does not collect personal information. No account is required."
"Your songbook content": "Imported songbook files remain under your control on your device or in your browser's local storage."
"Cookies and tracking": "The static support website does not add analytics or advertising trackers."
"Third-party services": "The website and web demo are hosted on GitHub Pages."
"Contact": "laurelltm@gmail.com".
No claims that website uses essential cookies, no made-up data retention or consent features.
4. Guide instructions must say "Swipe sideways to change songs", not swipe up/down. Mention Library menu and "Import books" when opening a book. Do not claim edits cannot be saved; remove "(it won't be saved)" if present.
5. All headline text is SOLID color, no gradient-filled letters. Avoid colored glow around the application preview; use clean grounded surfaces. Keep existing palette and design identity.
Return the same complete four-page presentation board as a single landscape image, all four main views preserved.
